intent: Prevent mature generated root flares, maintained tree-pit edging and low understory from intersecting or floating at the plaza-to-lawn interface while preserving existing gameplay collision.

rootFlareEnvelope.reasoning: The opening is sized from the generated root-flare geometry, not from a decorative decal radius. 0.94 m maximum centerline plus 0.195 x 0.58 m maximum tip radius gives a 1.0531 m conservative radial envelope; the 1.15 m opening leaves at least 96.9 mm against that bound before the inner curb face.

pitAssembly.manufacture: Small precast concrete edging modules are set tangentially around an exposed root-zone soil opening. Module visible length is the local 12-sided chord minus a 12 mm dry joint. The root-zone soil is a continuous visual volume extending below the lower lawn datum so no underside can become visible at boundary joints.
pitAssembly.mounting: Each curb module follows the actual supporting surface under its center: 8 mm embed where it bears on plaza paving and 6 mm embed where a boundary ring crosses lawn. This intentionally produces a grade step matching the approximately 50 mm plaza-to-lawn datum instead of leaving modules suspended over grass.
pitAssembly.interfacesGapsSeals: root flare -> exposed soil -> inner curb face -> 12 mm curb joint -> local pavement or lawn support. The intended construction soil surface is flush/slightly recessed; the generated fallback uses only a 1.5 mm positive render-separation bias over the retained coarse paving collision slab, which must not read as a visible raised lip in native 4K crops.
pitAssembly.orientationExposure: Horizontal root zone, upward rain/sun exposure, ordinary pedestrian and maintenance exposure; boundary modules follow local support grade rather than a single artificial world height.
pitAssembly.aging: Cause-based compaction near trunk and circulation-facing soil, fine aggregate exposure on curb, and ordinary runoff/dust only. No random damage narrative.
pitAssembly.geometryVsMaterial: Opening radius, soil volume, curb height, embed, module joints, support-grade steps and root clearance are geometry. Fine soil grains, pores, subtle aggregate, ordinary UV aging and roughness variation remain material detail.
pitAssembly.lodPolicy: Root flares remain through tree LOD0/1/2/3. Tree-pit substrate and curb remain static construction geometry. Understory remains a separate four-level animated-crossfade LODGroup.

understoryGrounding.reasoning: The stem mesh has finite radius, so these small positive origin offsets allow the stem cross-section to penetrate the supporting surface while preventing obvious z-fighting. Plants may not originate tens of millimetres above the root-zone soil.

materials.microstructure: approximately 1-8 mm mineral grains/aggregate with broader compaction variation
materials.wetness: disabled for the dry benchmark; a future wet state must follow catchment/contact logic and lower roughness only where water can physically persist
materials.uvAging: mild ordinary desaturation only; no painted sun/shadow information
materials.angularFresnel: weak dielectric grazing reflection; never metallic and never a baked highlight

materials.microstructure: fine exposed aggregate/pores below the physical chamfer scale
materials.wetness: dry benchmark; future wetting must be source/runoff dependent
materials.uvAging: small exposure-driven lightening permitted without stylized bleaching
materials.angularFresnel: broad subdued dielectric edge response generated by real light and the physical chamfer

materials.microstructure: bark fissures below root-flare silhouette scale
materials.angularFresnel: dielectric grazing response; root volume and contact are never faked with a painted dark halo

automaticFail: root flare visibly intersects pit curb or uninterrupted paving
tree-pit curb module visibly floats above its local support surface
root-zone soil volume shows a visible unsupported underside
understory stems visibly float above soil or grass
pit soil reads as a raised brown decal/slab because the 1.5 mm render-separation bias becomes visible
visible LOD pop or severe foliage shimmer
claiming visual quality without an actual Unity render

verification: Source/contract geometry only. Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime plus native 3840x2160 oblique/grazing crops are required before any Visual Fidelity points or critical-defect clearance are awarded.
